assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. NORTH wall: ivory three drawer medicine chest with faded small red cross, small supply bottles. RIGHT upper wall: glass medical cabinet. LOWER RIGHT: ONE horizontally oriented simple grey iron examination bed with pale blue-grey mattress and white pillow at right end, visible bed legs and side rail. Small existing-style instrument trolley beside bed, not in central walkway. Existing white-coated bespectacled medic stands centre-left beside work counter; orange prisoner stands in central aisle. Characters are small cartoon figures at correct game scale, bed long axis about 2.2 character heights, cabinet medium-sized; do not inflate furniture or characters. Keep central and south ingress walkway open. Sparse small medical supplies, no extra beds, no fancy machines, no modern high-tech screens, no photorealistic rendering, no excessive grain or grunge, no captions or watermark. Calm practical clinic, strongly match approved reference's left work area / upper cabinet / lower horizontal blue bed arrangement.
